title: macroframe
summary: MSUI now has current Benilla's rule-seated 384x512 macro editor and 297x298 name/icon popup. MacroFrameUiLaw owns the tabs, exact grid, selected-macro plate, body-editor/scroll furniture, action row, close X, popup slices, name field, archive-derived icon chooser and button rules. Existing slots 1-18 remain General and slots 19-36 form the character set. Execution now mirrors the reference division: each CR/LF-delimited body line enters the same ChatFrame submission path as typed input, so the complete implemented chat/slash surface is shared instead of a macro-only whitelist. Cast/spell/use and attack commands are available through that common path, and rank-qualified spell names resolve exactly. Focused and full clinical checks pass; live visual/input verification remains outstanding.

openItems.text: No name/icon picker popup (the reference MacroPopup: 20-icon paged grid + name editbox on Okay/Cancel) - macros are created in place and the icon cannot be chosen
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MacroFrameUiLaw owns the exact 297x298 TOPLEFT-on-frame-TOPRIGHT (-40,-40) popup, name/grid/scroll/button geometry and Okay state. GameLoop.Macro renders the authored four-slice shell and 5x4 picker, persists selected icons, and supports both New and Change Name/Icon. MacroIconCatalog mirrors BuildMacroIconList by enumerating mounted MPQ listfiles, filtering actual top-level Spell_/Ability_ BLP/TGA art, then case-insensitive sorting/deduping. Focused clinical checks pass.

openItems.text: No General vs Character-specific tab split (reference: two tabbed macro sets; MSUI has one flat 18-slot set)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MacroFrameUiLaw owns the current two-tab seats/fit and the exact 18-button set projection. Existing slots 1-18 remain General macros; slots 19-36 are the character-specific set, selected/edit/new/delete/drag routes use absolute ids, and action-bar macro title/icon execution accepts both ranges.

openItems.text: The geometry, state and actual-file catalog laws plus source fences pass. Needs owner-run live acceptance for 517-icon catalog population, scrolling, new/edit/cancel/escape persistence, selected art on the macro grid/action bar, and all three sound cues.

Live-verify the current main MacroFrame at representative gameplay scales: fitted General/character tabs, 36px grid and labels, set isolation/persistence, selected-macro plate, body editor wrapping/focus, external bar show-hide, wheel/arrows/drag scrolling to the final line, Change/Delete/New/Exit enable states, close X, drag to action bar from both macro sets, and preservation of pre-existing slots 1-18.
Live-verify MacroFrame beside another registered left panel: it must consume the resolved center seat and keep MacroPopup attached to the moved frame origin at its authored (-40,-40) offset.
No scrollbar on the body editor (reference MacroFrameScrollFrame)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MacroFrameUiLaw now owns the exact body ScrollFrame furniture (up 319,310; 53px track at 319,326; down 319,379), the reference's 14px explicit-line plus 48-character conservative wrap allowance, the 85px viewport floor, 20px step/wheel motion, range clamp and knob projection. GameLoop.Macro hosts the editor in a native-scrollbar-free law-sized child, clips it to the authored 286x85 viewport, and renders clickable disabled/pressed/highlight arrow states plus a draggable stock knob. Focused and full interface clinical checks pass; authenticated live input/visual verification remains tracked separately.

openItems.text: Macro execution supports only a small command subset, with 'Unsupported macro command' chat fallback (engine scope, noted for honesty)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ExecuteMacro now tokenizes body lines through MacroFrameUiLaw and feeds every runnable line into the same SubmitChatLine path as typed input, matching Benilla's EXECUTE_CHAT_LINE architecture. The former Unsupported macro command branch is gone; /cast and /spell share rank-aware resolution, /use, /startattack and /stopattack are common chat commands, and all existing chat/channel/group/emote routes are inherited automatically.

openItems.text: No open/close/save sounds (reference keeps igCharacterInfoOpen/Close, gsTitleOptionOK)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Opening/closing the macro frame now plays igCharacterInfoOpen/Close; opening and accepting/canceling the name/icon popup plays igCharacterInfoOpen and gsTitleOptionOK through the shared UI sound path. Escape and panel-replacement closure use the same centralized close routines.
